hard.title: Phase 2 integrity console
hard.strict: Strict evidence and audio timing enabled; legacy artifacts remain viewable and require revalidation.
hard.legacy: Legacy diagnostic mode. Enable strict contracts and provide evidence, claims and audio alignment before real production.
hard.truthNotice: Unexecuted live models, voices and video audits remain unverified. Test tones and Mock are not production acceptance.
hard.pricing: Pricing by worker ID: input_per_million / output_per_million in USD; multimodal also requires image_per_input / audio_per_input / video_per_input. Empty means unknown, not free. Budgets block calls without an estimate.
hard.ownerNotice: Each operation checks its owner. Humans control strict mode, budgets and relink; Research owns Evidence; Audit/Human decides claim candidates; Voice/Alignment owns timing.
hard.enableHelp: Submit an empty object. New scripts require ClaimUnit v2 and formal render requires the audio master clock.
hard.evidenceHelp: Provide evidence_id, source_id, locator, excerpt and both SHA256 hashes; they must exactly match the current source.
hard.claim-decisionHelp: Provide report_id, reviewer, decisions. Every candidate requires NON_CLAIM or REGISTER_CLAIM and a reason.
hard.audio-timingHelp: Submit AUDIO_TIMING_MAP bound to the approved Script and actual Voice; include alignment method, version, worker and phrase_ranges per segment.
hard.manifestHelp: Submit an empty object to pin dependency identities; missing files are never substituted.
hard.relinkHelp: Provide asset_id and path. Only files matching the pinned expected_hash are accepted.
hard.research-toolHelp: Provide tool, arguments and request_id. Local documents inside the project directory are implemented; unconfigured remote operations such as SEARCH return BLOCKED.
